brand_dna.category: Online-only home furniture retailer selling living room, bedroom, dining, office and outdoor pieces at discount prices, serving the USA with free local delivery in the Inland Empire, CA.
brand_dna.core_belief: They believe your home should reflect your style and comfort, and that showroom-quality furniture should be sold at the best prices available online.
proof_points: In business since 2006 with roots liquidating furniture from Las Vegas casinos like the Bellagio and MGM Grand
Low overhead model - direct from importer, virtual showrooms only, so savings pass to the customer
Free delivery in Los Angeles, Orange, Riverside and San Diego Counties on minimum order, using their own drivers
Damage exchange or replacement if reported within 48 hours of delivery
brand_dna.positioning: Value-first, no-showroom online furniture source that undercuts local retail on the same brands while keeping service personal.

voice_pillars.name: Warm and Homey
voice_pillars.desc: They frame furniture around comfort, family and spaces that feel personal, not just product specs.
voice_pillars.quote: rooms that pulse with warmth and character - the kind of spaces that make you feel right at home

voice_pillars.name: Straight-Talking Value
voice_pillars.desc: They are blunt about why they are cheaper and never hide the trade-offs of the online model.
voice_pillars.quote: We sell direct from the importer to the end user.

voice_pillars.name: Personal and Reachable
voice_pillars.desc: They lean on real people and easy contact to reassure shoppers nervous about buying furniture online.
voice_pillars.quote: no routine answering machines or voicemail

voice_pillars.name: Confident Insider
voice_pillars.desc: They speak like seasoned pros who know the furniture business and quietly flex their track record.
voice_pillars.quote: We can count our dissatisfied customers on one hand

phrases: make you feel right at home
showroom quality furniture at the best prices

icp: Practical Southern California and USA homeowners furnishing full rooms who want brand-name, showroom-quality furniture at the lowest price and value a personal, easy buying experience over a physical showroom.

personas.name: Deal-Savvy Homemaker
personas.description: A budget-conscious homeowner outfitting a room who is moved by the promise of the same furniture as local stores for a lot less money.

personas.name: Nervous First-Time Online Buyer
personas.description: A shopper hesitant to buy furniture online who is reassured by a long track record, real staff and easy phone contact.

personas.name: Inland Empire Nester
personas.description: A local family in LA, Orange, Riverside or San Diego County who values free local delivery by the company's own drivers and fast turnaround.

banned.claim: Calling the furniture 'sustainable' or 'eco-friendly' with no backing.
banned.why: FTC Green Guides - unqualified sustainability claim not supported anywhere on the site.

banned.claim: Describing wood pieces as '100% recycled' or 'zero impact'.
banned.why: FTC Green Guides - unverifiable recycled/impact claim with no evidence in product copy.

banned.claim: Marketing recliners as relieving back pain or correcting posture.
banned.why: Banned medical/orthopedic claim for this category; not supported by any product spec.
Shipping policy explicitly states shipping times are estimated and cannot be guaranteed.
FTC Green Guides - unqualified carbon neutrality claim with no verifiable proof.

banned.why: FAQ states dining sets, desks and beds in almost every case require assembly - claim would be false.
